lines.text: So a layer is: every token looks back at the ones before it, then each one goes through a small network on its own, with some tidying around both. And there are eighty of those?

lines.text: Eighty copies of the same thing?

Same design, not the same thing. Each layer has its own weights, its own learned numbers. And each one starts where the last one finished. What comes out of floor one is what goes into floor two, all the way up.

lines.text: And the threads in the picture?

Each thread is one token's path up the stack. The site draws every layer as the same map of meaning, so as a token climbs, you can see where each floor moves it. Watch them all at once, and they gather.

lines.text: Gather where?

Toward each other, and toward code. At the bottom, each word sat at its dictionary meaning: "job" among careers, "race" in sports. Floor by floor, each takes in more of the sentence, and they drift toward what the whole prompt is about.
